name: patch-lang
description: Patch: a tiny change-oriented programming language with machine-checked semantic change contracts, formal source/evidence correspondence, machine-checked integer range-analysis soundness, Lean-checkable certificates, causal provenance, and a browser-first cross-platform IDE

scripts.build:example: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target portable --out Score.patchapp
scripts.build:wasm: node src/cli.js build examples/score.patch --kind console --target wasm --out Score.wasm
